column1: # Cosimo III's cipher runs in Penn Ms. Codex 533, run by run. Transcription: transcriptions/reconciled_533_v2.tsv (sha256 d2866b78...); groups as paired in decode/decode_rec2_v3ctx.tsv.
# Key: key/key_v3.json (frozen, interline-attested) plus key/key_v3_context.json (ww = o, 62 = q: context only, NOT attested under any interline).

# letters: one entry per group. "x*" = the letter rests on an emended or reinterpreted digit (9 read as 5, 0 as 6, 7 as 3 or 2, an 8-like loop read as Cosimo's w, one sign shared by two groups); "x+" = the letter rests on a context-only value (ww = o or 62 = q); "?" = no value (unknown group or probable code number). The 9-to-5 readings: the independent verifier found that Cosimo's hooked head with a descender is one letter form used for undoubted 5s too, so these are readings of one form rather than corrections; they are still marked.

# italian: decoded cipher normalized, [..] = hole, [x] = letter supplied, (?) = doubtful. Clear text of the letter is NOT given here except the words next to the run (clear_before); it is mostly untranscribed outside f. 1r-1v.
# read: whole = every group read as Italian (with marked emendations); most / part = some groups read; none = not read.

# clear_before: four of these clear words were read differently by both passes of 16 Nov 2026 (25r a, 28v a, 56r a, 63r a); left unchanged here, see readings/clear_context_533.md and NOTES.md "## Transcription doubts".
